growth_signal.value: Says it is trusted by 3,000+ organizations; named in VivaTech Top 100 Rising European Startups 2026.

raised.value: $16M Series A (June 2024), plus an earlier seed

entry.idea: Companies have knowledge spread across many apps, so Dust lets teams build AI helpers that read that knowledge and do real work.
entry.lesson: When tools are everywhere, the glue that connects them with the right controls can be the product.
entry.name: Dust

growth.basis: substitute: VivaTech Top 100 criteria and 3,000+ customer claim
growth.reason: The VivaTech list requires at least EUR 5M revenue and 40% yearly growth, and the company claims 3,000+ customers.

market.reason: Almost any company could use AI helpers at work.

tech.reason: Solid product with many connectors and controls, but it builds on models from others and could be copied in months.

sources.title: Dust.tt: France's Rising Star in Generative AI

entry.twist: People and AI helpers work together in the same space, and teams can pick from 20+ AI models for each task.
entry.why_now: Firms want to use AI at work but need control over their data and permissions.
